remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600 -D__WINESRC__)

spec2def(xinput1_4.dll xinput1_4.spec)

# xinput1_4.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/xinput1_4-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# The same source as xinput1_3 (Wine's PARENTSRC), with xinput1_4's ordinal exports:
# XInputGetCapabilitiesEx (#108) and XInputGetAudioDeviceIds (#10, audio.c) are 1_4 only.
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(xinput1_4_shims OBJECT ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/dll/win32/xinput1_3/main.c audio.c)
target_link_libraries(xinput1_4_shims PRIVATE wine libhid libsetupapi libadvapi32 libuser32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libkernel32_vista libntdll)
set_wine_module(xinput1_4_shims)
add_cargo_module(xinput1_4 xinput1_4-cargo xinput1_4.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS xinput1_4_shims psdk)
